utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday, first of July. All here? Before we start, the charity bake sale on Friday—apparently last year's flapjack is still being talked about.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, the charity bake sale on Friday. That flapjack needed a permit to break into. Lovely flavour, mind.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Never mind that, whose new car is in the car park? The shiny one taking up about a bay and a half.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one where the dirt is doing structural work.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: We knew which one you meant before the second sentence.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, lovely. Actual factory stuff. What's already cleared?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the gas turbine two yesterday. That's done, not carrying it forward.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, that's off the outstanding list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the line 2 last night. All finished, that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Ah, nice. I saw it running when I came through.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Only an observation from me: saw the pressure on the pick and place on two dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: It recovered without anybody touching it, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Just mentioning what I saw, not asking for another job off the back of it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the IM1 hydraulic unit, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, still blocked then. Not something we can move today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same story elsewhere—still waiting on parts for the stretch wrapper, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Both sitting on parts, then. No change there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Let's get the actual jobs straight without mixing those back in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you replace the seals on the Main Water Isolation Valve?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll replace the seals on the Main Water Isolation Valve.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. That's with you.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Got it. The seals on the Main Water Isolation Valve, not a whole valve replacement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, if you've got a spare minute, can you schedule downtime for the GT2 bearing with production by Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just getting the downtime agreed with production, yeah? Not saying the bearing work itself is by Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Schedule the downtime by Thursday. If you've got a spare minute—that's where it sits priority-wise.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. I'll schedule downtime for the GT2 bearing with production by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round tomorrow at 9:30. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, rather than this morning? Sorry, you clipped out for a second.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, yeah. I'll send it then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Marcus. Fairly important, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 water valve? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, sorry, I can't take that. I haven't got access to the calibration kit, so I need to decline that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, not with Hannah Price then. Olu, can you take it instead—recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 water valve, normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that instead. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 water valve, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's the sensor calibration we're talking about, not changing the valve setup?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, sensor calibration. That's the job I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah. The pressure drop on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve is yours, separate from that calibration.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, separate job. I'll do the investigation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marc, can you run a function test on the guard switch on two next week, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run a function test on the guard switch on two next week, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry—talked over the end there. Next week, not being squeezed into this shift?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next week, yeah. Whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's how I've got it. Next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you go to Tollgate to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine one compressor next Tuesday? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll go to Tollgate next Tuesday to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine one compressor. Understood—it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Teams managed to deliver every word of that one. Must like a trip out.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Unlike me, it doesn't have to sit in the traffic.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha. Right, that's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you run the monthly fire alarm test by Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test by Wednesday. That's today, just so we're both on the same page?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today. Wednesday the first.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: First of the month always sneaks up. Feels like we only just had June.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Tell me about it. But yes, I've got the monthly fire alarm test by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. And neither of those parts-blocked jobs has somehow become live while we've been talking?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nope. IM1 hydraulic unit and stretch wrapper both still waiting. Nothing to do on either until the parts arrive.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And my pressure dip was just an observation. No outstanding action attached to that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Kept separate.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Makes a change having the finished stuff stay finished on the morning call.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Careful, you'll tempt fate. Back to discussing indestructible flapjack.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'm still defending it. Good dunking biscuit, if you've got a big enough mug.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Could use it to mark the parking bays for whoever owns that new car.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On that highly technical conclusion, we're done. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Cheers. Bye.
